$comment: GreetHub stock cards v1 catalog. Source of truth for pre-generated cards. Written by the Head of Design 2026-10-16. Nothing here has been rendered yet.

costEstimate.assumptions: Insides are typeset by us, not rendered. 4K final is an assumption (5.25x7.25 in at 300 DPI is 1575x2175 px); if 2K proves enough the cost drops to about $0.13 per card. Owner must approve a dollar cap before any run.
